Logs.Comment:
Hi, Luke from the messaging team here; just a quick summary on what's happened during the power cut so far. We are arranging for a team to attend an underground fault in the Meadow Lane area and also considering if a generator would be beneficial. Currently 11 properties are affected.

I'm sorry for the disruption, but I'll keep you informed with news from site. If you have any concerns, please call us on 08003163105.

Sent by Jack at 22:40 - Some customers have told us that they want to be notified about a power cut before it happens. We're sorry we couldn't give you advance notice about this power cut. The issue happened suddenly and without warning, leaving us with no time to alert customers.

Our electricity network is regularly inspected and maintained to help prevent outages, but occasionally an unexpected fault can lead to an unplanned power cut. It's similar to a car that's been fully serviced and passed its MOT but still breaks down without warning.
Thank you for your understanding and we will keep you updated about todays outage until you are restored.

All of our texts are written and sent personally by our team, and we'll let you know once our staff arrive.
